name: Barnum Museum
source: The Barnum Museum (barnum-museum.org) and its catalogue on Connecticut Collections (ctcollections.org)
note: The Barnum Museum is closed while its building is restored (reopening planned for 2030), so nothing inside is on view. Its catalogue on Connecticut Collections lists 1,002 records (General Tom Thumb and Lavinia Warren, Jenny Lind, Barnum’s homes, circus photographs, Bridgeport history); about 60,000 objects in all. On view: only the façade, from the sidewalk.
